title: Development, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Virtual Reality (VR) Training Module for Pot Room Activities at NALCO Smelter Plant, Angul, Odisha
scope_summary: NALCO seeks to implement an enterprise-grade AR/VR training solution for safety, operations, and maintenance activities at its Angul Smelter Plant. The project includes hardware, software, and integration services for immersive training in critical plant areas such as Pot Room activities, anode change processes, and emergency workflows.

title: Supply of Asset Performance Management System (APMS) for Numaligarh Refinery Expansion Project
scope_summary: Tender invited for the supply of an Asset Performance Management System (APMS) for the Numaligarh Refinery Expansion Project. The scope includes design, engineering, manufacturing, procurement of materials, assembly, inspection, testing, packing, and training for owner engineers.

title: Provision of Development of Web Based Asset Management Application for GE (North) Meerut Cantt
scope_summary: Tender invited for the development of a web-based asset management application for GE (North) Meerut Cantt. The project aims to provide a digital solution for managing assets within the specified government entity.
